install_deps.description: Installs the project's dependencies listed in requirements.txt. Run this after pulling changes or when imports fail with ModuleNotFoundError.

add_package.description: Installs a package. It is not recorded anywhere: also add it to requirements.txt, so that others get it too. Argument: the package name, optionally with a version (e.g., 'requests' or 'requests==2.32.3').

remove_package.description: Uninstalls a package. Also remove it from requirements.txt. Argument: the package name (e.g., 'requests').

list_packages.description: Lists the installed packages that no other installed package depends on, which are usually the project's direct dependencies, with their versions.

python_version.description: Shows the version of the Python that runs the commands.

python_doc.description: Shows the documentation and signatures of an installed module, class or function. Use it to check a library's API instead of guessing it. Argument: the full name (e.g., 'requests.Session.get' or 'pathlib.Path').

run_tests.description: Runs the whole test suite. Use this to verify changes before considering a task done.

run_test_file.description: Runs the tests of one file, or one test, which is faster than the whole suite while working on a change. Argument: the test file or test (e.g., 'tests/test_orders.py' or 'tests/test_orders.py::test_total').

run_tests_matching.description: Runs the tests whose names match an expression. Argument: part of the test names, optionally with and/or/not (e.g., 'total' or 'total and not slow').

run_failed_tests.description: Runs again only the tests that failed in the previous test run. Use it to check a fix.

lint.description: Checks the code for lint errors with ruff.

lint_rule.description: Checks the code for a single ruff rule or rule group only. Argument: the rule code (e.g., 'F401' for unused imports or 'E' for all pycodestyle errors).

format_check.description: Checks whether the code follows the project's formatting, without changing any files.

type_check.description: Checks the code for type errors with mypy.

npm_install.description: Installs the JS/TS dependencies defined in package.json.

npm_run_script.description: Runs a script defined in the 'scripts' section of package.json. Argument: the script name (e.g., 'build', 'test' or 'lint'). Do not use for long-running scripts such as 'dev' or 'start', as they are stopped at the timeout.

npm_test_file.description: Runs the JS/TS tests of one file with the project's test script (Jest or Vitest). Argument: the test file (e.g., 'src/cart.test.ts').

npm_test_name.description: Runs the JS/TS tests whose names contain the given text (Jest or Vitest). Argument: part of the test name (e.g., 'adds an item').

npm_package_info.description: Shows an npm package's description, latest version and dependencies from the registry. Argument: the package name, optionally with a version (e.g., 'zod' or 'zod@3').
